qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Quotations (RFQ) issued by the NYS Office of General Services for an Aggregate Hardware Buy, including submission deadlines, scope, and evaluation criteria.

quotes.quote: RFQ Title Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 RFQ Number 20-01
Request for Quotations 20-01

OGS is seeking competitive quotes from Contract holders of the OGS Group 73600 Award 22802 Information Technology Umbrella Contract – Manufacturer Based (Statewide) (“Manufacturer Umbrella Contract”) for the Lots indicated below.
Responses to the RFQ must be received by the deadline specified above.

findings.title: Only Lot 2 Manufacturer Umbrella Contract Holders May Bid; Resellers Disqualified
findings.fact: The RFQ is restricted to Contractors with an award for Lot 2 – Hardware on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract; bids from resellers will be disqualified.
findings.business_implication: If the bidder is not a Lot 2 contract holder, or if the response is submitted through a reseller, the bid will be rejected without evaluation.
findings.action_recommendation: Confirm active Lot 2 award status before allocating bid resources; ensure the response is submitted directly by the manufacturer/contract holder, not by a reseller.

quotes.quote: Quotes from Resellers will not be accepted.  Contractors must have an award for Lot 2 to bid on this RFQ.
Quotes under RFQ 20-01 will only be accepted from Lot 2 Contractors on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract; Resellers are not eligible to respond and any bids from a Reseller will be disqualified.

findings.title: All Proposed Products Must Be on Lot 2 Price List by RFQ Submission Deadline
findings.fact: All Products in Standard Configurations, Required Products, and Additional Products must already be on the Contractor's Lot 2 – Hardware price list at the time of the RFQ submission due date. OGS prioritizes related contract modification requests, but SKUs not on the approved price list may be removed from evaluation.
findings.business_implication: Any SKU not yet on the Lot 2 price list by 12/9/20 could cause the configuration to fail technical review or be removed from the response.
findings.action_recommendation: Audit every proposed SKU against the current Lot 2 price list; submit any required contract modification requests with the RFQ indicator as early as possible.

quotes.quote: All Products proposed as part of the Standard Configuration and Products proposed for Required Products, as well as any Additional Products, must be on the Contractor's Lot 2 - Hardware price list at the time of the RFQ Submission due date.

All proposed SKUs for proposed products offered in Attachment A – Technical Response must be on the Contractor’s approved Manufacturer Umbrella Contract Price List. Any Configuration that contains a SKU that is not included on the Manufacturer’s Umbrella Contract Price List may not proceed further in the evaluation process.

findings.title: Two USB Drives Required; No Hand-Delivery Due to COVID-19
findings.fact: Contractors must submit two clearly labeled, unprotected USB flash drives containing Attachment A, Attachment D, and the Manufacturer Information Page. OGS will not accept hand-delivered bids because of COVID-19; mail and package delivery services are still allowed.
findings.business_implication: Physical submission logistics are crucial; a late or improperly delivered bid may be rejected, and password-protected drives cannot be read.
findings.action_recommendation: Package and send via trackable mail/courier well before the 12/9/20 11:00 AM deadline; verify USB drives are readable and files are in unlocked Microsoft Office format.

quotes.quote: Two (2) digital storage devices (USB flash drive), clearly labeled, shall contain the following documents, completed in their entirety:

Bidders are hereby advised that due to COVID 19, OGS Procurement Services will not be accepting hand-delivered bids (mail and package delivery services are still allowed to access the building), nor granting access to any visitors to attend the Bid Opening.

findings.title: RFQ Timeline and Attachment C Financial Response Deadlines
findings.fact: RFQ released 11/3/20; questions due 11/13/20 5:00 PM EST; OGS responses 11/23/20; RFQ submission due 12/9/20 11:00 AM EST; OGS sends Attachment C on 1/21/21; Contractor returns completed Attachment C by 1/28/21 11:00 AM EST.
findings.business_implication: Missing any deadline can eliminate the bid; Attachment C is only issued to contractors who pass the technical evaluation.
findings.action_recommendation: Calendar all dates; submit questions by 11/13; complete technical response by 12/9; clear resources for a quick turnaround on Attachment C between 1/21 and 1/28.

quotes.quote: RFQ 20-01 Release 11/3/20
Attachment B - Contractor Questions and Comments Due 11/13/20 5:00pm EST
OGS Issues Responses to Questions and Comments 11/23/20
RFQ Submission Due ... 12/9/20 11:00am EST
OGS sends out Attachment C – Financial Response, which includes approved technical response 1/21/21
Contractor returns completed Attachment C – Financial Response 1/28/21 11:00am EST

findings.title: Technical Response Is Pass/Fail; Financial Response Is 100% of Score
findings.fact: The Technical Response (Attachment A, Attachment D, Manufacturer Information Page) is evaluated pass/fail. The Financial Response is the only scored element, with 50 points for Standard Configuration and 15/30/5 points for Required Products warranty/services, components, and peripherals respectively.
findings.business_implication: A bidder must pass technical review to be considered; award is determined solely by lowest evaluated financial score, so pricing competitiveness is the decisive factor.
findings.action_recommendation: Invest in meeting all mandatory technical specifications, then price aggressively to maximize financial score while protecting margins.

quotes.quote: Technical Response (Attachment A – Technical Response, Attachment D – Issue Escalation Plan, and Manufacturer Information Page): Pass/Fail   Financial Response : 100%

Total Financial Score is based on lowest cost and the points are weighted as follows: • Standard Configuration - 50 points • Required Products o Warranty/Services - 15 points o Components - 30 points o Peripherals - 5 points

findings.title: All Mandatory Fields Must Be Completed; Alterations to Forms Prohibited
findings.fact: All components within Standard Configurations and Required Products are mandatory. Failure to complete all required fields in Attachment A or Attachment C may result in rejection without further review. Adding/deleting worksheets, unlocking or rewriting formulas is prohibited.
findings.business_implication: A single incomplete field or unauthorized form modification can disqualify the entire bid.
findings.action_recommendation: Use OGS-provided templates exactly as issued; perform a completeness check before submission.

quotes.quote: ALL COMPONENTS WITHIN THE STANDARD CONFIGURATION AND ITS REQUIRED PRODUCTS ARE MANDATORY. Failure to complete all required fields in Attachment A – Technical Response or Attachment C – Financial Response may result in rejection of the RFQ Response without further review.

The addition or deletion of worksheets, columns, unlocking the document, rewriting formulas, or similar alterations to  any document is prohibited. OGS reserves the right to reject any Contractor Submission or portion(s) thereof determined to have been altered/modified by the Contractor from the original format.

findings.title: Quoted Pricing Cannot Exceed Net NYS Contract Price; Required Product Discounts Apply to All Additional Products
findings.fact: Quoted pricing must be at or below the Net NYS Contract Price on the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract. The discount percentage bid on a single Required Product in each category applies to all Additional Products in that same category, and discount percentages may be increased but not decreased during the agreement term.
findings.business_implication: A deep discount on one required product could force the same discount on a broad category of additional products, creating significant financial exposure over the contract term.
findings.action_recommendation: Model the financial impact of required-product discounts across the entire relevant additional product category before bidding; consider setting discount percentages that are sustainable for all products in the category.

quotes.quote: In no event may quoted pricing exceed the Net NYS Contract Price on the Manufacturer’s Umbrella Contract.
The discount that is bid on the single Product shall apply to all Additional Products in the same Required Product category, as described in Section 7.3.5 – Additional Product Discount.
The discount percentages may be increased, but not decreased during the term of the Agreement and any extensions.

findings.title: 0.50% Administrative Fee and Audit Penalty for Underpayment
findings.fact: Awarded contractors must pay an administrative fee of 0.50% of all sales under the agreement, due quarterly. If an audit finds administrative fees underpaid by more than 5%, the contractor must pay the audit cost or three times the discrepancy, whichever is higher.
findings.business_implication: The fee reduces net margin, and reporting errors can trigger punitive financial penalties as well as termination risk.
findings.action_recommendation: Build the 0.50% fee into pricing/profit models and implement strong sales-reporting and fee-remittance controls to avoid >5% discrepancies.

quotes.quote: The awarded Contractor(s) are required to pay an Administrative Fee in the amount of point five percent (0.50%) for all sales generated from this Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement.

If, as a result of any such audit, Administrative Fees are determined to have been underpaid by more than five percent (5%) for the period audited, Contractor shall pay the costs of such audit or three times the discrepancy, whichever is higher.

findings.title: IDIQ With No Purchase Guarantee; Estimated Value Approximately $40M
findings.fact: The RFQ states the estimated aggregate value is approximately $40 million, but the resulting agreements are Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), and there is no guarantee of volume, dollar value, or continued demand.
findings.business_implication: The bidder cannot rely on the estimated $40M; actual purchases may be substantially higher or lower depending on pricing and market conditions.
findings.action_recommendation: Set pricing that is competitive but not dependent on high volume to remain viable; acknowledge the no-guarantee language in the bid.

quotes.quote: The estimated dollar value of the aggregated award of the fourteen (14) Standard Configurations in this RFQ, based on historical purchases under previous awards, is approximately $40 million.
There is no guarantee of volume to be purchased
There is no guarantee of dollar value to be purchased

findings.title: One-Year Initial Term With Extensions Up to One Year and Possible Short-Term Extension
findings.fact: The Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement term is one year, beginning only upon OGS execution and posting. OGS may extend all or some configurations for up to one additional year, and may unilaterally extend for up to three months (or six months with contractor concurrence) if a replacement agreement has not been issued.
findings.business_implication: The contractor could be bound for up to approximately 2.5 years, including the initial term and extensions, without renegotiation.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan pricing and supply for a potentially longer duration than the initial one-year term; assess willingness to consent to short-term extensions.

quotes.quote: The term of the Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement shall be one (1) year. The term shall not commence until OGS execution and posting of the final executed documents to the Awarded Contractor(s). OGS reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to extend all or some Configurations of the Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement for a period up to an additional one (1) year upon written notice to the Contractor.

In the event a replacement Agreement has not been issued, any Agreement let and awarded hereunder by the State, may be extended unilaterally by the State for an additional period of up to three (3) months upon notice to the Awarded Contractor with the same terms and conditions as the original Agreement including, but not limited to, prices and delivery requirements.

findings.title: Award Conditioned on eMarketplace Participation
findings.fact: A winning bidder may not receive an award until it agrees to participate in the NYS eMarketplace. The eMarketplace link must be the only ordering system link displayed if the contractor also maintains a website; contractor websites cannot have web-based ordering capability.
findings.business_implication: eMarketplace participation is effectively mandatory for award, and website restrictions limit direct online ordering.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for hosted/punch-out catalog setup and eMarketplace integration; confirm internal capabilities before bidding.

quotes.quote: The Contractor with the winning bid for each Configuration may not receive an award until Contractor agrees to participate in the eMarketplace.

If after establishing an eMarketplace account, the Contractor opts to maintain its own Aggregate Hardware Buy website, the eMarketplace link must be the only ordering system link displayed on the page.

findings.title: Supply Shortage Prioritization Requires NYS Orders First and OGS Approval for Exceptions
findings.fact: In a supply shortage, an awarded contractor must make reasonable efforts to prioritize New York State Authorized User orders over orders from extension customers. If the contractor wants to prioritize non-NYS orders over NYS orders, it must contact OGS for approval before fulfilling those orders.
findings.business_implication: This obligation could require the contractor to reallocate inventory to NYS and may conflict with existing customer commitments; failure to seek approval could breach the agreement.
findings.action_recommendation: Develop allocation procedures that favor NYS orders; establish an internal approval workflow for any exception and maintain OGS contact information.

quotes.quote: In the event of a supply shortage an Awarded Contractor must make all reasonable efforts to prioritize orders placed under this originating Agreement for New York State Authorized Users, over any orders made by extension of this Agreement to customers outside of New York State Authorized Users.

In addition, in the event that the Awarded Contractor believes it necessary to prioritize orders made by extension of this Agreement to customers outside of New York State Authorized Users, over orders placed under this originating Agreement for New York State Authorized Users, the Awarded Contractor must contact OGS for approval prior to fulfilling such orders.

findings.title: EOL Product Replacement Obligations at No Additional Charge
findings.fact: Awarded contractors must provide OGS with at least 60 days' notice before EOL for Standard Configurations and products. All EOL products purchased by Authorized Users must remain under warranty or be replaceable at no additional charge. If a contractor fails to provide acceptable EOL notice or a replacement configuration, OGS may award the configuration to the next-lowest bidder.
findings.business_implication: The contractor bears lifecycle risk and potential replacement cost; failure to manage EOL could result in loss of the configuration to a competitor.
findings.action_recommendation: Monitor product lifecycles closely; provide timely EOL notices and prepare replacement models with equal or better specifications at no higher price.

quotes.quote: All EOL Replacement Products purchased by Authorized Users must remain under warranty or be replaceable at no additional charge to the Authorized Users.

During the term of the Agreement, should the awarded contractor fail to provide acceptable notice of EOL Standard Configuration(s); fail to submit a replacement Standard Configuration via the process outlined in Appendix 2 – Price List Modification Procedure in the timeframe referenced above; or, is unable to provide a replacement model with specifications that meet or exceed the specifications of the original awarded Configuration, OGS reserves the right to award the Configuration to the Contractor with the next lowest bid from RFQ 20-01 for that Configuration that is willing to accept the Configuration award without rebidding.

findings.title: OGS May Unilaterally Revise Non-Material Attachments and Modify Specifications
findings.fact: OGS reserves the right to unilaterally make non-material revisions, changes, and/or updates to templates and attachments without a formal amendment, and to modify a specification within Standard Configuration or Required Product categories prior to the Financial Evaluation upon written notice.
findings.business_implication: Contractors may be bound by changes to attachments/specifications after bid submission, affecting scope or pricing assumptions; no consent required for non-material changes.
findings.action_recommendation: Design bid pricing to accommodate potential specification changes; review subsequent OGS notices and attachments carefully.

quotes.quote: Unilaterally make non-material revisions, changes and/or updates to any templates and/or Attachments to the Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement without processing a formal amendment and/or modification;

Modify a specification within the Standard Configuration or Required Product categories in Attachment A – Technical Response or Attachment C – Financial Response prior to the Financial Evaluation, upon written notice to Contractors that have submitted a quote.

findings.title: OGS May Terminate for Delivery Delays or Reporting Failures and Award to Next Bidder
findings.fact: OGS can terminate the agreement in whole or in part if it becomes aware of multiple incidents of delivery delays, and failure to submit accurate sales reports on time may result in termination of the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract and activation of the replacement contractor provision. If terminated, OGS may award to the next highest-scoring contractor without rebidding.
findings.business_implication: Performance failures can have cascading consequences beyond the aggregate agreement, including loss of the underlying umbrella contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Implement robust delivery tracking, sales reporting, and compliance escalation processes to avoid termination triggers.

quotes.quote: If OGS becomes aware of multiple incidents of delays in delivery, OGS reserves the right to terminate the Agreement in whole or in part.
Failure to submit accurate reports on a timely basis may result in termination of the Contractor’s Manufacturer Umbrella Contract in whole or in part and activation 7.23 Replacement Contractor.

findings.title: Contractor Is Wholly and Solely Responsible for Reseller Actions
findings.fact: Contractors are permitted to use resellers for order fulfillment, delivery, installation, and other functions, but contractors must invoice and receive payment directly from Authorized Users, and contractors remain wholly and solely responsible for the actions of resellers acting on their behalf.
findings.business_implication: The contractor assumes full liability for any reseller errors, including fulfillment and compliance failures, without ability to pass responsibility to OGS.
findings.action_recommendation: Use only OGS-approved resellers and contractually bind resellers to the same performance and compliance obligations; maintain oversight and audit controls.

quotes.quote: Contractors remain wholly and solely responsible for the actions of the Resellers acting on their behalf as part of the aggregate purchase, as well as the performance of all Products, and conformity with the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract and any agreement resulting from this RFQ.

Contractors are allowed to utilize authorized Resellers for the following purposes, including but not limited to: • The fulfilment of orders; • Coordination of deliveries; • Installation of Products purchased under any resulting Aggregate Agreement; or • Other functions that fall within the scope of the purchase by the Authorized User.

findings.title: EPEAT Certification Minimums Required at Time of Award
findings.fact: Desktops, laptops, and computer monitors provided under this Agreement must meet at least EPEAT Silver certification at award; Interactive Displays must meet at least EPEAT Bronze. Quarterly reporting of EPEAT registered products is required.
findings.business_implication: Proposed products that do not meet EPEAT levels may not be awardable, and ongoing reporting is required.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify EPEAT registration status for every proposed desktop, laptop, and monitor; build EPEAT data capture into quarterly sales reporting.

quotes.quote: Desktops, laptops, and computer monitors provided under this Agreement are required to have achieved a minimum certification of EPEAT Silver at the time of award, apart from the Products included in the Interactive Displays Configuration. Interactive Displays classes will be required to meet a minimum certification of EPEAT Bronze at the time of award.
Awarded Contractors are required to provide quarterly reporting on the number of EPEAT registered products purchased under this Agreement.

findings.title: Unclear Precedence Between Manufacturer Umbrella Contract and Aggregate Agreement Terms
findings.fact: The RFQ states all purchases are in accordance with the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract plus additional RFQ terms, while the order of precedence in Section 7.3 lists 'Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement TERMS AND CONDITIONS' first but does not explicitly identify which document contains those terms.
findings.business_implication: If a conflict arises between the umbrella contract and RFQ terms, it may be unclear which provision controls, creating contractual ambiguity and potential dispute.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek clarification from OGS during the question period about which document constitutes the 'Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement TERMS AND CONDITIONS' and how conflicts with the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract will be resolved.

quotes.quote: This RFQ incorporates the terms and conditions of the Contractor’s OGS Information Technology Umbrella Contract – Manufacturer Based (Statewide) (“Manufacturer Umbrella Contract”) including executed amendments and the additional terms and conditions set forth in this RFQ, its Attachments, and Appendices.

Th resulting Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement is comprised of the following documents. Any conflicts or inconsistencies among such documents shall be resolved by giving precedence to the documents in the following order: 1. Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 Agreement TERMS AND CONDITIONS;

findings.title: Specific Liability and Indemnity Provisions Not Provided in RFQ
findings.fact: The RFQ incorporates the Manufacturer Umbrella Contract by reference, but the supplied RFQ pages do not include the actual liability, indemnification, or limitation-of-liability clauses that would govern the resulting agreement. Unable to determine the full liability exposure from the available document evidence.
findings.business_implication: The bidder cannot fully assess potential financial exposure or insurance requirements from the RFQ alone; these terms are contained in the underlying umbrella contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Obtain and review the full Manufacturer Umbrella Contract (including all amendments) and specifically evaluate Sections related to liability, indemnity, insurance, and dispute resolution before bidding.

quotes.quote: This RFQ incorporates the terms and conditions of the Contractor’s OGS Information Technology Umbrella Contract – Manufacturer Based (Statewide) (“Manufacturer Umbrella Contract”) including executed amendments and the additional terms and conditions set forth in this RFQ, its Attachments, and Appendices.

The terms and conditions of the Contractor’s Manufacturer Umbrella Contract including any Amendments and the additional terms and conditions set forth in this RFQ 20-01 Section 7 - Terms and Conditions govern the resulting award under RFQ 20-01.
